name: makaron-cli
description: Give Codex a creative agent. Pass complete creative requests and source media to Makaron Chat.

interface.longDescription: Pass any complete creative request and source media to Makaron Chat. Makaron plans and produces images, video, music, and motion design in a persistent project that a human can continue editing in makaron.app.
defaultPrompt: Pass this complete creative brief and its source files to Makaron Chat.
Ask Makaron Chat to turn this image into the finished media described in my request.
Continue this Makaron project with my complete follow-up request.
